senses.gloss: m. (v. חוֹמֶר II) joint, knot, bead, amulet.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 73b:1">Kidd. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>תלי ח׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>רמי חוּמְרֵי</he>) if the child is found with an amulet (beads, by which the mother intimated the hope of future identification) … it is not considered a foundling (v. <cite ref="A02334"><he>אֲסוּפִי</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>חוּמְרֵי</he>. Ib. 9ᵃ top <he>ח׳ פתכייתא</he> glass-beads.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147b">Sabb. 147ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ח׳ שדרא</he> the vertebrae (v. <cite ref="H00347"><he>חוּלְיָא</he> I</cite>).
Gitt. 69ᵃ top עקרבא דשב ח׳ a scorpion with seven joints (Rashi: seven shades of color, stripes); v. חוּמַרְתָּא.
